description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a small research and engineering team developing AI technology for synthetic media detection and digital fraud prevention. You will combine rigorous research with practical model development, helping bring reliable approaches into production.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Investigate methods for deepfake detection, synthetic media analysis, and fraud prevention.

 - Read, assess, and reproduce relevant research to identify promising approaches.

 - Design experiments, establish baselines, and evaluate models on realistic data.

 - Implement research ideas and collaborate with engineering to bring successful methods into production.

 - Analyze failure cases and improve model reliability, generalization, and computational efficiency.

 - Document methods and findings, contribute to research papers, and prioritize work around practical problems.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of experience training deep learning models in PyTorch, including taking at least one model from concept to production; overall experience may range from 3 to 10+ years.

 - An MS or PhD in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent research experience.

 - Strong machine learning foundations and experience building, training, and evaluating models.

 - Computer vision knowledge, including CNNs, vision transformers, and their tradeoffs at small parameter counts.

 - Experience in synthetic media detection, image or video forensics, audio spoofing detection, generative models, or adversarial robustness.

 - Ability to critically assess research papers, design experiments, communicate findings clearly, and translate research into shipped software.

 - Evidence of research and engineering ability through shipped systems, publications, open-source work, or substantial applied projects; experience deploying models under real-world latency and reliability constraints is valuable.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is flexible based on experience and candidacy. The package includes a performance bonus and 0.25% to 1% equity. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in New York, New York, United States.
